document:468.text:
Unbelievable! What I observed today overturns everything I had assumed.
Although Lady Starfallen is a Hypofiend, she is not as dangerous as she looks.
She has a good track record and seems largely uninterested in causing destruction.
And those ferocious waves were merely her frolicking? How fascinating!
document:468.source_cn:
难以置信！今天的观察彻底颠覆了我之前的假设。
“小裙”并非如它外形的那般，是灾害性或充满破坏欲的魔物。
结合之前的记录，它似乎对摧毁物体不感兴趣。
而那些强大的水浪只是它在玩耍？这可真是有趣的假设！

document:469.text: Her body is almost entirely water. Normal attacks barely harm her and only stir up bigger splashes.
document:469.source_cn: “小裙”的身体几乎由纯水构成，普通攻击对她来说根本不痛不痒，顶多算是在帮她搅动水花。

document:470.text:
Ancient texts indicate that the Serene Lyceum once possessed a collection of rare artifacts.
One of these artifacts, forged a long time ago, can be used to communicate with her.
With the aid of this artifact, the caster may be able to penetrate her water barrier.
document:470.source_cn:
据查阅到的文献记载，莱希拉姆曾收藏数件古老的“法器”。
这些法器最初由学院先辈所制，可以用以与“小裙”进行交流。
在法器的辅助下，施术者也许能突破其水体防御的屏障。
